title: Start the kit log
happened: The team chose a private sign-out log for its shared camera and sound kit. Setup prepared the project and recorded how the team would use it.
decision: You chose to start setup for a private team log.

title: Name the people in a loan
happened: The team settled two names: the borrower uses an item, and the booking steward enters the loan. The piece was parked without changing the tool.
decision: You chose those names and parked the piece.

title: Carry on with an unchecked fact
happened: The person asked to send overdue lists by text. The kit recorded that the service had not been checked and described the risks before the person accepted them.
decision: You chose to continue with the unchecked fact and record your acceptance of the risks.

title: Build one ready piece
happened: The agent added the number of overdue days, ran the available checks and saved the change for review.
decision: You asked for the change and its checks, then chose to leave it unmerged.

title: Keep extra requests out of the build
happened: The request did not match a ready piece, so the agent stopped before editing and sent it to shaping.
decision: You asked about extra requests while keeping the build within the agreed piece.

title: Merge after trying the preview
happened: After the person tried the preview, the kit checked the change, reviewed it, merged it and put the new sign-in wording live.
decision: You confirmed the preview looked right and asked to merge the change.

title: Compare the live copy with main
happened: The kit found that the live tool matched the project and explained that an earlier version could be restored. It changed nothing live.
decision: You asked for a live check and whether the old version could be restored.

title: Check the project records
happened: The record check found that most records matched. It named two records that had drifted and made no changes.
decision: You asked the kit to check the records without making changes.

title: Return after a stopped session
happened: The session had stopped during a repair. The kit reported what needed attention and changed nothing.
decision: You asked what needed attention before anything changed.
